cursor.note: Cursor also loads .claude/skills/, .codex/skills/ and .agents/skills/ for compatibility. A user who has already cloned Heimdall can point Cursor at the checkout instead of installing this pack — but never generate a pack INTO one of those paths inside this repo (ADR-0008 C3: a Cursor session would load all 22 skills three times).
cursor.friction: ~40 active tools across all servers before tools are silently dropped (Heimdall ships 5). No MCP hot-reload — reload the window after editing mcp.json.

codex.friction: config.toml is TOML, not JSON, and the table is [mcp_servers.<name>] — the one config dialect that genuinely differs. `codex mcp add` is safer than hand-editing; the emitted fragment is for review or append.

antigravity.note: ~/.gemini/config/skills/ is the only path all three Antigravity variants (AGY, IDE, CLI) read. Installing to a variant-specific path is the most likely 'it silently did nothing' failure.
antigravity.friction: Also readable at ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json or workspace .agents/mcp_config.json. Remote (HTTP) servers use `serverUrl`, not `url` — irrelevant for our stdio server today, and a trap the day HTTP transport un-defers.
